## Cell Proportions by Fetal Sex N=1009

Making a boxplot and performing a t-test for cell differences by fetal sex

Update: 4/23/26 to change the formatting of some of the cell names.

### Upload Data and Load Packages
```{r data and packages}
#Load Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(forcats)
library(ggbreak)

#Load Data- Using N=1009 for the heatmap
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/DeconvolutionData/ImputedCellProportions_withcollapse_CANDLEGAPPS_N1009_111825.RData")
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/FilteredCovariates_CANDLEGAPPS_111825.RData")

```

### Update Cell Type Formatting
```{r cell type formatting}
#Remove underscores from column names
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res) <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res) <- tools::toTitleCase(colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))

#Fix some immune cell type issues
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("Cd4", "CD4+", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("Cd8", "CD8+", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("Cd14", "CD14+", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("Fcgr3a", "FCGR3A", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("t Cells", "T-cells", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("b Cells", "B-cells", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("GZMB", "GzmB+", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("GZMK", "GzmK+", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
#Fix pathways_id variable
colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res)  <- gsub("Pathways Id", "pathways_id", colnames(ciber_cells_impute_res))
```


### Prepare Data
```{r data prep}
CellProp <- ciber_cells_impute_res

rownames(CellProp) <- CellProp$pathways_id

CellProp <- CellProp %>%
  dplyr::select(-pathways_id)

summary(CellProp)

```

### Fetal Sex Boxplot
```{r fetal sex boxplot}

#Reorganize
CellProp$pathways_id <- rownames(CellProp)
CellProp_long <- pivot_longer(CellProp,
                              cols=-pathways_id,
                          names_to="CellType", 
                          values_to="Proportion")
#Pull Fetal Sex Info
FetalSex <- CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars %>%
  dplyr::select(FetalSex, pathways_id)

#Add Annotation
CellProp_long <- full_join(CellProp_long,FetalSex, by=c("pathways_id"))

#Add Cell Category Information
print(unique(CellProp_long$CellType))
VascularStromalCells <-c("Fetal Fibroblasts", "Fetal Nucleated Red Blood Cells", "Fetal Endothelial Cells", "Fetal Mesenchymal Stem Cells") 
FetalImmune <- c("Fetal CD14+ Monocytes", "Fetal CD14+ Monocytes", "Fetal Natural Killer T-cells", "Fetal Memory CD4+ T-cells", "Fetal Hofbauer Cells", "Fetal Natural Killer GzmB+ GzmK+", "Fetal Naive CD8+ T-cells")
MaternalImmune <- c("Maternal CD8+ Activated T-cells", "Maternal FCGR3A Monocytes", "Maternal CD14+ Monocytes", "Maternal Natural Killer Cells", "Maternal B-cells", "Maternal Naive CD8+ T-cells")
Trophoblasts <- c("Fetal Cytotrophoblasts", "Fetal Extravillous Trophoblasts", "Fetal Syncytiotrophoblast")

mapping <- c(
  setNames(rep("Vascular and Stromal Cells", length(VascularStromalCells)), VascularStromalCells),
  setNames(rep("Fetal Immune Cells", length(FetalImmune)), FetalImmune),
  setNames(rep("Maternal Immune Cells", length(MaternalImmune)), MaternalImmune),
  setNames(rep("Trophoblast Cells", length(Trophoblasts)), Trophoblasts)
)

# Apply it to your dataframe (assuming your column is called 'CellType')
CellProp_long$CellCategory <- mapping[CellProp_long$CellType]

#Add annotation about significance
# t-test for fetal sex
t_test_results <- CellProp_long %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    t_test = list(t.test(Proportion ~ FetalSex)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tidied = map(t_test, broom::tidy)
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidied) %>%
  select(CellType, estimate1, estimate2, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)

t_test_results

Sig_t_test_fetalsex <- t_test_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value<0.05)
print(Sig_t_test_fetalsex)

sig_map <- t_test_results %>%
  select(CellType, p.value) %>%
  mutate(Sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))

CellProp_long <- CellProp_long %>%
  left_join(sig_map, by = "CellType")

ordered_levels <- levels(fct_reorder(CellProp_long$CellType, CellProp_long$Proportion, .fun = median))


sig_colors <- CellProp_long %>%
  distinct(CellType, Sig) %>%
  mutate(Color = if_else(Sig == "Yes", "red", "black")) %>%
  select(CellType, Color) %>%  # Keep only these 2 columns for deframe
  deframe()

#Make Boxplot of all cell types together
ggplot(CellProp_long, aes(
    y = fct_reorder(CellType, Proportion, .fun = median),
    x = Proportion,
    fill = FetalSex
  )) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "", x = "Proportion") +
  theme(
    # Use the named vector to color only the labels in the current plot order
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = sig_colors[ordered_levels], face = "bold")
  )

# Make Boxplot faceted by cell category
#Make column to indicate which cell types should be colored based on significance
CellProp_long <- CellProp_long %>%
  mutate(CellTypeColored = if_else(
    Sig == "Yes", 
    paste0("<span style='color:red;'>**", CellType, "**</span>"), 
    CellType
  ))

#Plot
library(ggtext)
ggplot(CellProp_long, aes(
    # Reorder based on Proportion, but use the colored strings for the axis
    y = fct_reorder(CellTypeColored, Proportion, .fun = median, .desc = FALSE),
    x = Proportion,
    fill = FetalSex
  )) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~CellCategory, scales = "free", ncol = 1) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "", x = "Proportion", fill = "Fetal Sex") +
  theme(
    # This is the "magic" line that tells ggplot to render the HTML tags
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold") # Makes category names pop
  )


```

### Evaluate difference amounts
```{r difference amounts}
FemaleOnly <- CellProp_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(FetalSex=="F") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sig=="Yes")
FemaleSummary <- FemaleOnly %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_val   = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(Proportion, na.rm=TRUE), 
    sd_val     = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

MaleOnly <- CellProp_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(FetalSex=="M") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sig=="Yes")
MaleSummary <- MaleOnly %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_val   = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(Proportion, na.rm=TRUE), 
    sd_val     = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

CombinedSummary <- inner_join(FemaleSummary, MaleSummary, 
                              by = "CellType", 
                              suffix = c("_female", "_male"))


CombinedSummary <- CombinedSummary %>%
  mutate(Difference = (median_val_female - median_val_male)*100) %>%
  select(CellType, Difference) 

print(CombinedSummary)


```
